def build(ctx):
    ctx.length(24)

    hips = ctx.bone('hips')
    spine = []
    b = ctx.bone('spine')
    while b and b != hips:
        spine.append(b)
        b = ctx.parent(b)
    n = len(spine)

    neck = None
    for name in ctx.bones:
        if 'neck' in name.lower():
            neck = name
    head = ctx.bone('head')
    r_up = ctx.bone('right upperarm'); r_fore = ctx.bone('right forearm'); r_hand = ctx.bone('right hand')
    l_up = ctx.bone('left upperarm'); l_fore = ctx.bone('left forearm')
    l_thigh = ctx.bone('left thigh'); l_shin = ctx.bone('left shin'); l_foot = ctx.bone('left foot')

    def body(f, back=0.0, side=0.0, twist=0.0):
        for s in spine:
            ctx.key(f, s, turn=[('right', back / n), ('forward', side / n), ('up', twist / n)])

    def look(f, back=0.0, side=0.0, turn=0.0):
        if neck:
            ctx.key(f, neck, turn=[('right', back * 0.4), ('forward', side * 0.4), ('up', turn * 0.4)])
            ctx.key(f, head, turn=[('right', back * 0.6), ('forward', side * 0.6), ('up', turn * 0.6)])
        else:
            ctx.key(f, head, turn=[('right', back), ('forward', side), ('up', turn)])

    # Upper body: snap back on impact, overshoot, stagger, shake it off, settle.
    body(3, back=22, side=-4, twist=6)
    body(6, back=27, side=-5, twist=8)
    body(9, back=14, side=-3, twist=4)
    body(12, back=4)
    body(17, back=-2)
    body(20, back=-4)
    body(22, back=-1)

    # Head whips back a touch harder than the chest, then shakes it off.
    look(3, back=24, side=-6)
    look(6, back=30, side=-8)
    look(9, back=12)
    look(12, back=-6, turn=16)
    look(14, back=-6, turn=-16)
    look(16, back=-4, turn=11)
    look(18, back=-3, turn=-6)
    look(21, back=2)

    # Arms fling forward/out from inertia; pan arm stays out to the side, clear of body and ground.
    for f, ra, la, rb, lb in (
        (3, (0.75, -0.30, 0.40), (-0.70, -0.25, 0.45), 30, -30),
        (6, (0.78, -0.18, 0.40), (-0.72, -0.12, 0.45), 40, -40),
        (9, (0.65, -0.45, 0.20), (-0.60, -0.50, 0.25), 25, -25),
        (13, (0.40, -0.80, -0.30), (-0.40, -0.88, 0.05), 12, -10),
        (18, (0.25, -0.80, -0.50), (-0.38, -0.92, -0.05), 6, -5),
    ):
        ctx.key(f, r_up, aim=ra)
        ctx.key(f, r_fore, turn=[('forward', rb)])
        ctx.key(f, l_up, aim=la)
        ctx.key(f, l_fore, turn=[('forward', lb)])
    ctx.key(6, r_hand, turn=[('forward', 15)])
    ctx.key(13, r_hand, turn=[('forward', 0)])

    # One stagger step: the front foot lifts and stomps back down in the same spot.
    ctx.key(5, l_thigh, turn=[('right', 0)])
    ctx.key(5, l_shin, turn=[('right', 0)])
    ctx.key(5, l_foot, turn=[('right', 0)])
    ctx.key(8, l_thigh, turn=[('right', 22)])
    ctx.key(8, l_shin, turn=[('right', -40)])
    ctx.key(8, l_foot, turn=[('right', 15)])
    ctx.key(11, l_thigh, turn=[('right', 0)], interp='LINEAR')
    ctx.key(11, l_shin, turn=[('right', 0)], interp='LINEAR')
    ctx.key(11, l_foot, turn=[('right', 0)], interp='LINEAR')

    ctx.note('Hips are never moved, so the planted foot cannot slide; stagger is a lift-and-stomp of the front foot in place.')

import math


def build(ctx):
    ctx.length(36)

    hips = ctx.bone('hips')
    spine = []
    b = ctx.bone('spine')
    while b and b != hips:
        spine.append(b)
        b = ctx.parent(b)
    n = len(spine)

    neck = None
    for name in ctx.bones:
        if 'neck' in name.lower():
            neck = name
    head = ctx.bone('head')
    r_up = ctx.bone('right upperarm'); r_fore = ctx.bone('right forearm'); r_hand = ctx.bone('right hand')
    l_up = ctx.bone('left upperarm'); l_fore = ctx.bone('left forearm')

    def body(f, back=0.0, side=0.0):
        for s in spine:
            ctx.key(f, s, turn=[('right', back / n), ('forward', side / n)])

    def look(f, back=0.0, side=0.0):
        if neck:
            ctx.key(f, neck, turn=[('right', back * 0.4), ('forward', side * 0.4)])
            ctx.key(f, head, turn=[('right', back * 0.6), ('forward', side * 0.6)])
        else:
            ctx.key(f, head, turn=[('right', back), ('forward', side)])

    def norm(v):
        l = math.sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2])
        return (v[0] / l, v[1] / l, v[2] / l)

    # Upper body thrown back hard, held through the skid, lurches forward to catch balance, settles.
    body(3, back=30)
    body(6, back=36, side=3)
    body(10, back=33, side=-3)
    body(14, back=26, side=3)
    body(18, back=12, side=-2)
    body(21, back=-10)
    body(25, back=4)
    body(29, back=-2)

    # Head lags on impact (whiplash), then flops back, then follows the recovery.
    look(3, back=-12)
    look(6, back=18)
    look(10, back=14, side=-5)
    look(14, back=10, side=5)
    look(18, back=0)
    look(21, back=-8)
    look(25, back=5)
    look(29, back=-2)

    # Arms fly straight up on the shove.
    ctx.key(3, r_up, aim=(0.55, 0.82, 0.15))
    ctx.key(3, l_up, aim=(-0.55, 0.82, 0.15))
    ctx.key(3, r_fore, turn=[('forward', 10)])
    ctx.key(3, l_fore, turn=[('forward', -10)])
    ctx.key(3, r_hand, turn=[('forward', 0)])

    # Windmill: big forward circles out at the sides, arms out of phase.
    # The circle is kept in the upper arc and out to the side so the pan never swings into the legs or the floor.
    frames = [6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18]
    for i, f in enumerate(frames):
        a = math.radians(90 + i * 100)
        amp = 1.0 - i * 0.08
        rv = norm((0.65, 0.35 + 0.6 * math.sin(a) * amp, 0.7 * math.cos(a) * amp))
        a2 = a + math.pi
        lv = norm((-0.65, 0.35 + 0.6 * math.sin(a2) * amp, 0.7 * math.cos(a2) * amp))
        ctx.key(f, r_up, aim=rv)
        ctx.key(f, l_up, aim=lv)
        ctx.key(f, r_fore, turn=[('forward', 15 + 10 * (i % 2))])
        ctx.key(f, l_fore, turn=[('forward', -(15 + 10 * ((i + 1) % 2)))])

    # Catch balance: arms thrown out wide for the lurch, then drop back down.
    ctx.key(21, r_up, aim=(0.85, 0.05, 0.35))
    ctx.key(21, l_up, aim=(-0.85, 0.05, 0.35))
    ctx.key(21, r_fore, turn=[('forward', 20)])
    ctx.key(21, l_fore, turn=[('forward', -20)])
    ctx.key(25, r_up, aim=(0.45, -0.70, -0.25))
    ctx.key(25, l_up, aim=(-0.50, -0.85, 0.05))
    ctx.key(25, r_fore, turn=[('forward', 8)])
    ctx.key(25, l_fore, turn=[('forward', -8)])
    ctx.key(29, r_up, aim=(0.25, -0.80, -0.50))
    ctx.key(29, l_up, aim=(-0.38, -0.92, -0.08))
    ctx.key(21, r_hand, turn=[('forward', 10)])
    ctx.key(29, r_hand, turn=[('forward', 0)])

    ctx.note('No root/hip travel or rotation: the game slides him back; feet stay locked while only the upper body reacts.')

import math


def build(ctx):
    ctx.length(36)

    hips = ctx.bone('hips')
    spine = []
    b = ctx.bone('spine')
    while b and b != hips:
        spine.append(b)
        b = ctx.parent(b)
    n = len(spine)

    neck = None
    for name in ctx.bones:
        if 'neck' in name.lower():
            neck = name
    head = ctx.bone('head')
    r_up = ctx.bone('right upperarm'); r_fore = ctx.bone('right forearm'); r_hand = ctx.bone('right hand')
    l_up = ctx.bone('left upperarm'); l_fore = ctx.bone('left forearm')

    def body(f, back=0.0, side=0.0):
        for s in spine:
            ctx.key(f, s, turn=[('right', back / n), ('forward', side / n)])

    def look(f, back=0.0, side=0.0, turn=0.0):
        if neck:
            ctx.key(f, neck, turn=[('right', back * 0.4), ('forward', side * 0.4), ('up', turn * 0.4)])
            ctx.key(f, head, turn=[('right', back * 0.6), ('forward', side * 0.6), ('up', turn * 0.6)])
        else:
            ctx.key(f, head, turn=[('right', back), ('forward', side), ('up', turn)])

    def arms(f, rd, ld, rb, lb):
        ctx.key(f, r_up, aim=rd)
        ctx.key(f, l_up, aim=ld)
        ctx.key(f, r_fore, turn=[('forward', rb)])
        ctx.key(f, l_fore, turn=[('forward', lb)])

    # Impact: head driven straight down, chest crunches, arms jolt stiff out to the sides.
    body(2, back=-8)
    look(2, back=-28)
    body(4, back=-12)
    look(4, back=-34)
    arms(2, (0.70, -0.62, 0.05), (-0.72, -0.62, 0.15), 5, -5)
    arms(5, (0.78, -0.52, 0.10), (-0.80, -0.50, 0.20), 3, -3)
    ctx.key(2, r_hand, turn=[('forward', 0)])

    # Dizzy wobble: upper body and head trace two circles; the head lags behind the chest.
    for i, f in enumerate(range(8, 24, 2)):
        a = math.radians(i * 90)
        amp = 1.0 - i * 0.07
        body(f, back=-6 + 9 * math.cos(a) * amp, side=10 * math.sin(a) * amp)
        look(f, back=-8 + 12 * math.cos(a - 1.2) * amp, side=16 * math.sin(a - 1.2) * amp)
        sw = math.sin(a - 0.8) * amp
        arms(f, (0.55 + 0.08 * sw, -0.80, -0.20), (-0.55 + 0.08 * sw, -0.82, 0.05), 10, -10)

    # Shake it off: quick head shakes, then settle back to idle.
    look(25, back=-4, turn=22)
    look(27, back=-3, turn=-22)
    look(29, back=-2, turn=12)
    look(31, back=0, turn=-4)
    body(26, back=-3)
    body(30, back=1)
    arms(27, (0.40, -0.80, -0.40), (-0.42, -0.90, 0.00), 6, -6)
    arms(31, (0.25, -0.78, -0.55), (-0.38, -0.92, -0.08), 3, -3)
    ctx.key(31, r_hand, turn=[('forward', 0)])

    ctx.note('This rig has no eye bones, so the crossed-eyes read comes from the circling head wobble only.')
